name: reiven-io
description: Zero-knowledge encrypted file and note sharing

scripts.vendor: npm run vendor:crypto && npm run vendor:qr
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute reiven-io-db --file=./migrations/001_init.sql --local && wrangler d1 execute reiven-io-db --file=./migrations/002_receiver_delete.sql --local && wrangler d1 execute reiven-io-db --file=./migrations/003_notes.sql --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute reiven-io-db --file=./migrations/001_init.sql --remote && wrangler d1 execute reiven-io-db --file=./migrations/002_receiver_delete.sql --remote && wrangler d1 execute reiven-io-db --file=./migrations/003_notes.sql --remote
